moments.title: Glastonbury 2027 Tickets Sold Out
moments.blurb: General admission tickets for Glastonbury 2027 sold out in under 45 minutes on October 4th, with a resale of cancelled tickets confirmed for Spring 2027.

angles.name: Ticket Rush Aftermath
angles.copy: Glastonbury 2027 tickets are GONE! If you missed out, don't despair – there's always the resale in Spring. Who's still dreaming of Worthy Farm?

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Another year, another Glastonbury ticket scramble! Were you one of the lucky ones, or are you holding out for the resale next spring?

moments.title: Taylor Swift Holds UK No.1 Single
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' remains at No. 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart for a second consecutive week (chart dated Oct 9th), while Blossoms hit No. 1 on the Albums Chart.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: She's done it again! Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' is still your UK No.1 single. What's your favourite track from the album?

angles.name: New Album No.1
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Blossoms for hitting No.1 on the Official Albums Chart! What a week for UK music. What are you listening to this weekend?

moments.title: New Welsh Drama 'The Party' on ITVX
moments.blurb: The new five-part British drama 'The Party', starring Luke Evans and Sarah Solemani, and filmed in Wales, is set to premiere on ITVX on Sunday, October 11th.

angles.name: Welsh TV Premiere
angles.copy: A new Welsh-filmed drama 'The Party' hits ITVX tomorrow! Starring Luke Evans, this five-part series looks unmissable. Will you be watching?

angles.name: Weekend Binge Watch
angles.copy: Looking for a new drama this weekend? 'The Party', a new series filmed right here in Wales, premieres tomorrow on ITVX! Perfect for a Sunday binge.

moments.blurb: Major UK theme parks like Alton Towers (Scarefest), Thorpe Park (Fright Nights), Chessington (Howl'o'ween), and Legoland (Brick or Treat) are running their Halloween events now through early November.

angles.name: Family Frights
angles.copy: From Brick or Treat at Legoland to Howl'o'ween at Chessington, there's plenty of family-friendly frights happening across the UK this October!
